name: rag-v1-vs-v2
hypothesis: With identical chunks, embeddings, retrieval mode and top-k, v1 and v2 reach the same retrieval quality within noise (|delta MRR| < one question). v2 costs less per month and needs less operational work. Latencies differ by less than 100 ms at p50.

levels.v1: Amazon OpenSearch Service managed domain; our ingestion pipeline embeds and indexes chunks
levels.v2: Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Base on an Amazon S3 Vectors store; KB sync embeds and indexes chunks

controlled.corpus: data/knowledge_base/ (same git commit for both arms)

chunking.implementation: our chunker writes one file per chunk; KB data source uses chunkingStrategy NONE
chunking.prompt_format: rag_client prepends '<title> | <section>' to each passage it gives the LLM

parity_check.metric: mean Jaccard overlap of top-k chunk_ids
